result.description:
## Network Analyst
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and analytical Network Analyst to join our team and play a key role in maintaining, optimising, and evolving our organisation's network infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for researching and analysing network architecture, recommending strategies for network design and planning, and ensuring systems operate at peak performance. This role suits a detail-oriented professional with a strong technical background who is equally comfortable working on strategic planning as they are on day-to-day network operations. You will collaborate closely with IT teams and stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions across the organisation.
## Key Responsibilities
- Analyse, develop, and evaluate complex network architecture, system design specifications, data models, and diagrams to support the configuration, integration, and ongoing development of computer systems
- Research, monitor, and assess network infrastructure to ensure all systems are correctly configured and consistently operating at optimal performance levels
- Monitor network traffic, activity, capacity, and usage on an ongoing basis to maintain network integrity, identify anomalies, and proactively address performance issues before they escalate
- Identify opportunities for improvement across network operations and recommend enhancements to integrated hardware, software, communications, and operating systems
- Design, plan, and coordinate network architecture strategies that align with the organisation's broader technology goals and operational requirements
- Perform routine and scheduled network maintenance, including software and hardware upgrades, patch management, and system backups to ensure continuity and resilience
- Troubleshoot and resolve network faults, connectivity issues, and performance degradation, providing timely support to internal teams and end users
- Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including topology diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures
- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, providing informed recommendations on tools and solutions that could improve network capability and efficiency
- Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support infrastructure projects, system integrations, and technology upgrades
- Contribute to the development and enforcement of network policies, standards, and security protocols to safeguard the organisation's data and systems
- Assist in capacity planning and forecasting to ensure the network infrastructure can support current and future organisational demands
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a network analysis, network engineering, or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, technologies, and concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, and OSPF
- Proven experience monitoring and managing enterprise network environments using industry-standard tools and platforms
- Solid understanding of network security principles, firewalls, access controls, and best practices
- Experience with network hardware from leading vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, or Palo Alto
- Ability to analyse complex technical data, interpret performance metrics, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve network issues efficiently under pressure
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work autonomously, and contribute effectively within a team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent vendor-specific credentials
- Experience working within large-scale or enterprise-level network environments
- Familiarity with cloud networking platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
- Knowledge of network automation tools and scripting languages such as Python or Ansible
- Experience with SD-WAN technologies and software-defined networking concepts
- Exposure to ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed service provider (MSP) environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking technology team that values innovation and continuous improvement
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications and training programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available to support work-life balance
- Competitive remuneration package with clearly defined career progression pathways
- Work on diverse and meaningful infrastructure projects that directly impact the performance and reliability of the wider organisation
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

result.description: INNOVATIVE ENGINEERING DESIGNS PTY LTD  Innovative Engineering Designs Pty Ltd is currently seeking  an experienced Structural Engineer  to join our growing team. Work on exciting high-rise residential developments, premium commercial projects, and major civil infrastructure works across the Gold Coast and Southeast Queensland.   Benefits   Work with an established engineering consultancy specialising in innovative structural and formwork engineering solutions.  Be involved in a diverse range of commercial, residential and infrastructure projects across Australia.  Join a collaborative and supportive team that values technical excellence, innovation and continuous professional development.  Gain exposure to challenging and technically rewarding engineering projects using industry-leading design practices.  Opportunities for ongoing learning, career progression and professional growth.  Work in a positive workplace culture that encourages teamwork, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.  Competitive remuneration package based on skills and experience.    Task & responsibilities   Design, analyse and review structural and formwork systems for commercial, residential and infrastructure projects in accordance with Australian Standards and engineering principles.  Perform structural analysis to assess the behaviour, strength, stability and serviceability of structures under static and dynamic loading conditions.  Prepare, interpret and review engineering drawings, calculations, specifications and technical documentation.  Develop practical, safe and cost-effective structural solutions that meet client requirements, project specifications and regulatory standards.  Coordinate with architects, builders, contractors and other engineering disciplines to ensure efficient project delivery.  Conduct engineering assessments of existing structures and provide recommendations for modifications, strengthening or remediation where required.  Assist in determining appropriate construction methodologies, materials and quality standards for structural and formwork systems.  Review design changes, assess their structural implications and provide timely engineering advice throughout project delivery.  Provide technical support during construction, including responding to site queries and reviewing engineering issues as they arise.  Undertake site inspections to verify construction compliance with engineering designs and identify any structural concerns.  Ensure all engineering work complies with relevant Australian Standards, building codes, workplace health and safety requirements and company quality procedures.  Prepare engineering reports and maintain accurate project records and documentation.  Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying innovative engineering solutions and promoting best practice within the business.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.  At least one year of relevant post-qualification experience as a Structural Engineer or in a closely related role.  Demonstrated experience in structural analysis and design for commercial, residential and/or infrastructure projects.  Proficiency in structural analysis and design software, together with experience using AutoCAD and other relevant engineering applications.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop practical and cost-effective engineering solutions.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare technical reports and liaise effectively with clients, contractors and project stakeholders.  Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing deadlines and work both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.  Commitment to workplace health and safety, quality assurance and continuous professional development.  Reliable, safety-minded, and a positive team player  Proficient in English   About Company     Innovative Engineering Designs (IED) is a specialist Australian engineering consultancy business, delivering innovative formwork design solutions to the construction industry. Based on the Gold Coast, IED works with leading builders and contractors across a diverse range of commercial, residential and infrastructure projects.    As one of the few engineering firms dedicated exclusively to formwork engineering, IED is committed to providing practical, efficient and sustainable design solutions that meet the evolving needs of modern construction. The company prides itself on engineering excellence,   innovation, environmental responsibility and delivering high-quality outcomes through collaboration with clients and industry partners.    At IED, employees are valued for their technical expertise, professionalism and commitment to continuous improvement, offering an opportunity to contribute to challenging projects within a supportive and forward-thinking team. result.description:
Operating since 1982, Werner Engineering has an unparalleled reputation as the one stop engineering workshop of choice. They use the latest technology to offer fast, accurate and high quality workmanship to minimise down time and increase productivity and efficiency for their clients.

They are locally owned Mackay-based machining and fabrication workshop, specialising the manufacture and repair of parts for the mining, transport, sugar, agricultural and local industries

Werner Engineering is looking for Welders to join their team of professionals on a full time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
